releaseNotes: Update v1.0.7: Re-targeted managed core payload for pure .NET Framework 4.0 (v4.0.30319) with native Win32 bootstrapper. Native bootstrapper checks for .NET 4.0 and provisions dotNetFx40_Full_x86_x64.exe on vanilla Windows 7 out-of-the-box. Strictly preserves all existing DSC signers, NICD signers, eGramSwaraj, and PFMS tools on the computer.
